SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)")
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cds
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.numtsttakr > 0
  AND s.numge1500::numeric / s.numtsttakr > 0.3

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN doc = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN doc = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE statustype = 'Merged' AND county = 'Orange'

SELECT s.mailstreet, s.school
FROM satscores AS sa
JOIN schools AS s ON sa.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE sa.avgscrmath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sa.avgscrmath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
  AND "Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND "Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 / "Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18

SELECT s.school, s.doctype
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM frpm f2
    WHERE f2."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded'
  )

SELECT ROUND(("FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0))::numeric, 6) AS eligible_frpm_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.soc = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", f."District Code"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.admfname1 = 'Alusine'

SELECT s.school, f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.gsserved = 'K-9' AND s.county = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.numtsttakr, 0))::numeric, 2)
FROM schools sc
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = sc.cdscode
WHERE TRIM(sc.charternum) IN ('0756', '756')
  AND LOWER(TRIM(sc.mailcity)) = 'san diego'

SELECT s.ncesschool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f.cdscode IN ('01751010130583', '01612910137588', '01611760134270')
  AND f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" = (
      SELECT MAX("Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
      FROM frpm
      WHERE cdscode IN ('01751010130583', '01612910137588', '01611760134270')
  )

SELECT DISTINCT admemail1
FROM schools
WHERE county = 'San Bernardino'
  AND city = 'San Bernardino'
  AND doc = '54'
  AND soc = '62'
  AND opendate >= DATE '2009-01-01'
  AND opendate <= DATE '2010-12-31'
  AND admemail1 IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.city
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.cdscode = '01611920113902'
  AND s.eilcode = 'HS'
  AND s.county = 'Alameda'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12'

SELECT s.school, s.city
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.eilcode = 'HS'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND f."Low Grade" IN ('10', '11', '12')
ORDER BY s.school

SELECT s.school, s.mailstreet
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.doc = '02'
  AND t.rtype = 'S'
  AND t.avgscrread = (
      SELECT MAX(t2.avgscrread)
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN satscores t2 ON t2.cds = s2.cdscode
      WHERE s2.doc = '02'
        AND t2.rtype = 'S'
  )

WITH base AS (
    SELECT s.school,
           s.gsserved,
           UPPER(TRIM(split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1))) AS low_g,
           UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 2), ''), split_part(s.gsserved, '-', 1)))) AS high_g
    FROM schools s
    LEFT JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.ncesdist = '0613360'
      AND s.statustype = 'Active'
      AND s.gsserved IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(t.numtsttakr, 0) = 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT school,
           gsserved,
           CASE
               WHEN low_g IN ('P', 'PS', 'PK') THEN -2
               WHEN low_g = 'TK' THEN -1
               WHEN low_g = 'K' THEN 0
               WHEN low_g ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN low_g::int
               ELSE NULL
           END AS low_rank
    FROM base
    WHERE high_g = '12'
)
SELECT school, gsserved
FROM ranked
WHERE low_rank IS NOT NULL
  AND low_rank = (SELECT MIN(low_rank) FROM ranked WHERE low_rank IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY school

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores
WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa'
  AND rtype = 'S'
  AND numtsttakr > (
      SELECT numtsttakr
      FROM satscores
      WHERE cds = '07618040730051'
  )

SELECT s.avgscrmath, s.numtsttakr
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON sc.cdscode = s.cds
WHERE s.cds = '01611190130609'
  AND sc.charter = 1
  AND sc.fundingtype = 'Directly funded'

WITH sb AS (
    SELECT s.school, s.phone, ss.numge1500
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE ss.rtype = 'S'
      AND ss.numge1500 IS NOT NULL
      AND (s.doctype ILIKE '%Statewide Benefit%'
           OR s.doctype ILIKE '%State Board of Education%')
)
SELECT school, phone
FROM sb
WHERE numge1500 = (SELECT MAX(numge1500) FROM sb)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode)
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON ss.cds = s.cdscode
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE ss.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.mailcity = 'San Francisco'
  AND (ss.avgscrread + ss.avgscrmath + ss.avgscrwrite) >= 1500
  AND f."District Type" IN ('Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')

SELECT f."Low Grade"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.ncesdist = '0632640'
  AND f."Low Grade" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE
           WHEN f."Low Grade" = 'P' THEN -2
           WHEN f."Low Grade" = 'T' THEN -1
           WHEN f."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 0
           WHEN f."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(f."Low Grade" AS integer)
           ELSE 99
         END
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)", 0))::numeric, 2)
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f
  ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
 AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
WHERE s.soctype ILIKE '%Youth Authority%'

SELECT s.school, s.eilname
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.cdscode = '01612590136051'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2'
  AND f."County Name" = 'Alameda'

WITH sbe AS (
    SELECT s.school, s.admemail1, ss.numge1500
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.doctype = 'State Board of Education'
      AND ss.rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT school, admemail1
FROM sbe
WHERE numge1500 = (SELECT MAX(numge1500) FROM sbe)

WITH ms AS (
    SELECT f."School Type" AS school_type,
           f."School Name" AS school_name,
           s.latitude
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    WHERE s.latitude IS NOT NULL
      AND (f."School Type" ~* '\mmiddle\M' OR f."School Name" ~* '\mmiddle\M')
)
SELECT school_type, school_name, latitude
FROM ms
WHERE latitude = (SELECT MAX(latitude) FROM ms)

WITH sch AS (
    SELECT cdscode, admfname1, admfname2, admfname3
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND school IS NOT NULL
),
names AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.cdscode, v.fname
    FROM sch s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (s.admfname1), (s.admfname2), (s.admfname3)) AS v(fname)
    WHERE v.fname IS NOT NULL
),
top2 AS (
    SELECT fname, COUNT(*) AS c
    FROM names
    GROUP BY fname
    ORDER BY c DESC, fname ASC
    LIMIT 2
),
dist AS (
    SELECT cdscode, district
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND school IS NULL
      AND doctype IN ('Unified School District',
                      'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District',
                      'County Office of Education (COE)')
)
SELECT d.district AS district_name,
       t.fname AS first_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT n.cdscode) AS num_schools
FROM dist d
CROSS JOIN top2 t
LEFT JOIN names n
       ON LEFT(n.cdscode, 7) = LEFT(d.cdscode, 7)
      AND n.fname = t.fname
GROUP BY d.cdscode, d.district, t.fname
ORDER BY d.district, t.fname

SELECT s.fundingtype AS funding_category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS num_charter_schools,
       SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment_k12,
       ROUND((AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") * 100)::numeric, 2) AS avg_pct_frpm_eligible,
       ROUND(AVG(sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite)::numeric, 2) AS avg_combined_sat
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f
  ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
 AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
LEFT JOIN satscores sat
  ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.charter = 1
  AND s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.fundingtype

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(s.numtsttakr, 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_test_takers
FROM schools sc
LEFT JOIN satscores s
  ON s.cds = sc.cdscode AND s.rtype = 'S'
WHERE sc.county = 'Los Angeles'
  AND sc.opendate >= DATE '2007-01-01'
  AND sc.opendate < DATE '2008-01-01'
  AND substring(sc.cdscode from 8 for 7) <> '0000000'
  AND (sc.doctype LIKE '%School District%' OR sc.doctype LIKE 'County Office of Education%')

SELECT f."School Name",
       f."Low Grade",
       f."Enrollment (K-12)",
       COALESCE(s.numtsttakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
FROM schools sc
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = sc.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = sc.cdscode AND s.rtype = 'S'
WHERE sc.soctype = 'State Special Schools'
  AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
ORDER BY CASE
           WHEN f."Low Grade" IN ('P', 'PK') THEN -1
           WHEN f."Low Grade" = 'K' THEN 0
           WHEN f."Low Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST(f."Low Grade" AS integer)
           ELSE NULL
         END DESC NULLS LAST,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC NULLS LAST,
         f."School Name" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM frpm f
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500
  AND f."School Name" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."School Code" IS NOT NULL
  AND f."School Code" <> '0000000'
  AND (CASE WHEN f."High Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN f."High Grade"::int END) BETWEEN 1 AND 8
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE s.cds = f.cdscode
      AND s.numtsttakr > 0
  )

SELECT f."Charter Funding Type" AS charter_funding_type,
       COUNT(*) AS num_active_schools,
       SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment,
       SUM(f."FRPM Count (K-12)") AS total_frpm
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND f."District Type" = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
  AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
  AND s.statustype = 'Active'
GROUP BY f."Charter Funding Type"
ORDER BY CASE f."Charter Funding Type" WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

WITH closed AS (
    SELECT s.school, s.district, s.county, ss.avgscrwrite
    FROM satscores ss
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
    WHERE s.statustype = 'Closed'
      AND ss.rtype = 'S'
      AND ss.avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT school, district, county, avgscrwrite
FROM closed
WHERE avgscrwrite = (
    SELECT MAX(avgscrwrite)
    FROM closed
    WHERE avgscrwrite < (SELECT MAX(avgscrwrite) FROM closed)
)

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS avg_schools_per_month
FROM schools
WHERE county = 'San Diego'
  AND doc IN ('52', '54', '56')
  AND school IS NOT NULL
  AND opendate >= DATE '1980-01-01'
  AND opendate < DATE '1981-01-01'

SELECT ROUND(
    (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*))::numeric,
    1
) AS percentage
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.rtype = 'S'
  AND ss.avgscrmath > 400

SELECT s.school,
       s.county,
       s.district,
       s.city,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)",
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)",
       f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)",
       t.numtsttakr,
       t.avgscrread,
       t.avgscrmath,
       t.avgscrwrite,
       t.numge1500
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores t ON t.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE s.cdscode = '01612590137943'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores t
  ON t.cds = s.cdscode AND t.rtype = 'S'
WHERE s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.eilname = 'High School'
  AND s.state = 'CA'
  AND (s.soctype IS NULL OR s.soctype NOT ILIKE '%nonpublic%')
  AND COALESCE(t.numtsttakr, 0) = 0

SELECT
    s.county AS county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
    ROUND(AVG(ROUND((f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100)::numeric, 2)), 2) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(ROUND((f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) * 100)::numeric, 2)), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_charter_schools,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_non_charter_schools,
    ROUND(AVG((sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite)::numeric), 2) AS avg_sat_score
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE s.county = (SELECT county FROM schools WHERE cdscode = LPAD('1612590125716', 14, '0'))
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
  AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
GROUP BY s.county

WITH target AS (
    SELECT 'Santa Barbara' AS county
    UNION
    SELECT county FROM schools WHERE cdscode IN ('01100170109835', '1100170109835')
)
SELECT t.county, COUNT(s.cdscode) AS num_exclusive_virtual
FROM target t
LEFT JOIN schools s ON s.county = t.county AND s.virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY t.county
ORDER BY num_exclusive_virtual DESC, t.county ASC

WITH alameda AS (
    SELECT
        s.cdscode,
        s.school,
        s.charter,
        s.gsserved,
        f."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::numeric / f."Enrollment (K-12)"::numeric AS rate
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
    WHERE s.county = 'Alameda'
      AND RIGHT(TRIM(s.gsserved), 2) = '12'
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
      AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    a.school AS school_name,
    ROUND(a.rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
        WHEN a.charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN a.charter = 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS charter_school,
    a.gsserved AS grades_served,
    CASE
        WHEN sat.avgscrread IS NULL OR sat.avgscrmath IS NULL OR sat.avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance_level
FROM alameda a
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = a.cdscode
WHERE a.rate = (SELECT MAX(rate) FROM alameda)

WITH v AS (
    SELECT cdscode, county, school
    FROM schools
    WHERE virtual = 'F'
),
cnt AS (
    SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM v
    GROUP BY county
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT county, n, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY n DESC) AS r
    FROM cnt
),
top AS (
    SELECT county, n FROM ranked WHERE r <= 5
),
sc AS (
    SELECT v.county, v.school, s.avgscrread,
           MAX(s.avgscrread) OVER (PARTITION BY v.county) AS mx
    FROM v
    JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = v.cdscode
    WHERE s.avgscrread IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT t.county,
       t.n AS virtual_school_count,
       COALESCE(sc.school, 'None') AS school_name
FROM top t
LEFT JOIN sc
       ON sc.county = t.county
      AND sc.avgscrread = sc.mx
ORDER BY t.n DESC, t.county, school_name

WITH max_math AS (
    SELECT MAX(ss.avgscrmath) AS max_math
    FROM satscores ss
    JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
    WHERE s.statustype = 'Active'
      AND ss.rtype = 'S'
      AND ss.numtsttakr >= 10
)
SELECT
    s.school AS school_name,
    s.phone,
    s.website,
    ss.avgscrread,
    ss.avgscrmath,
    ss.avgscrwrite,
    s.charter,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    ROUND((f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" * 100)::numeric, 2) AS pct_eligible_frpm,
    m.max_math AS highest_avg_math,
    m.max_math - ss.avgscrmath AS points_below_highest
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
CROSS JOIN max_math m
WHERE s.cdscode = LPAD('7618040113118', 14, '0')

SELECT s."school", s."street"
FROM "frpm" f
JOIN "schools" s ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
  AND f."Low Grade" IN ('9', '10', '11', '12')
ORDER BY f."cdscode" ASC

SELECT f."County Name" AS county_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.cdscode) AS num_schools
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON s.cds = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND s.rtype = 'S'
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
  AND s.numge1500 >= 1
GROUP BY f."County Name"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f.cdscode) >= 1
ORDER BY num_schools DESC, county_name ASC

SELECT s."school", s."street"
FROM "frpm" f
JOIN "schools" s ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE s."school" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s."school") <> ''
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 30
  AND (
        f."High Grade" IN ('K', 'KG', 'PK', 'P', 'TK')
        OR (f."High Grade" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST(f."High Grade" AS integer) <= 8)
      )

SELECT s.admfname1, s.admlname1
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.rtype = 'S'
  AND s.county = (SELECT county FROM schools WHERE cdscode = LPAD('1611430131177', 14, '0'))
ORDER BY ss.numge1500 DESC NULLS LAST, ss.cds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.street, s.city, s.zip, s.state
FROM satscores ss
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.rtype = 'S'
  AND ss.numtsttakr >= 700
ORDER BY ss.numge1500::numeric / ss.numtsttakr ASC,
         CAST(SUBSTRING(ss.cds FROM 8 FOR 7) AS BIGINT) ASC,
         ss.cds ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.city, COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS magnet_provision2_schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
WHERE s.magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" LIKE '%Provision 2%'
GROUP BY s.city

SELECT id
FROM cards
WHERE bordercolor = 'borderless'
  AND (cardkingdomfoilid IS NULL OR cardkingdomid IS NULL)

SELECT s.county AS county_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(sat.numtsttakr), 0) AS total_test_takers
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND s.magnet = 1
GROUP BY s.county

WITH base AS (
    SELECT f.cdscode,
           f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_cnt,
           f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enr,
           f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS share
    FROM frpm f
    WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
      AND f."Educational Option Type" = 'Traditional'
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100
      AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
),
parts AS (
    SELECT cdscode, 1 AS ord, 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part_label
    FROM base
    WHERE frpm_cnt = (SELECT MAX(frpm_cnt) FROM base)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cdscode, 2 AS ord, 'smallest FRPM share' AS part_label
    FROM base
    WHERE share = (SELECT MIN(share) FROM base)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '04615150435602', 3, 'the CDS code from my notes'
)
SELECT p.part_label,
       s.school AS school_name,
       s.county,
       s.city,
       s.mailstreet AS mailing_street,
       s.mailcity AS mailing_city,
       s.mailstate AS mailing_state,
       s.mailzip AS mailing_zip,
       s.website,
       f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
       f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS frpm_share,
       (sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite) AS avg_total_sat,
       sat.numge1500 * 100.0 / NULLIF(sat.numtsttakr, 0) AS pct_sat_takers_1500_plus,
       s.opendate AS opening_date,
       CASE WHEN s.closeddate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status
FROM parts p
JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = p.cdscode
JOIN schools s ON s.cdscode = p.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = p.cdscode
ORDER BY p.ord

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM rulings
    GROUP BY uuid
),
maxc AS (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) AS m FROM counts
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.name, c.artist, c.ispromo
FROM cards c
JOIN counts ct ON ct.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE ct.cnt = (SELECT m FROM maxc)
SELECT id FROM cards WHERE dueldeck = 'a'

SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT text, ' ') AS text
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Benalish Knight'

SELECT s."school" AS school_name,
       s."street" AS street,
       s."city" AS city,

SELECT ta.buildupplayspeedclass

WITH latest AS (

)
SELECT ROUND(

FROM latest

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT m.country_id, v.pid
    FROM match m
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
        (m.home_player_1), (m.home_player_2), (m.home_player_3), (m.home_player_4),

),
counts AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.player_api_id) AS cnt

    LEFT JOIN player pl ON pl.player_api_id = mp.pid AND pl.weight <= 160

SELECT name

SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS matches_played

 AND p.player_api_id IN (

 )
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'

SELECT d.a2

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)

    SELECT district_id

)

WITH l AS (

)

FROM trans t

SELECT dp.account_id,

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (pa.player_api_id)
           pa.player_api_id,
           pa.overall_rating,
           pa.defensive_work_rate

filtered AS (

),
avg_all AS (

SELECT ROUND(((f.overall_rating - a.avg_rating) / a.avg_rating * 100)::numeric, 2) AS pct_higher

CROSS JOIN avg_all a
WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'

SELECT d.type, COUNT(DISTINCT d.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.a11 > 8000 AND di.a11 <= 9000
  AND d.type <> 'OWNER'
GROUP BY d.type

SELECT a.frequency, o.k_symbol
FROM account a
JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = 3
  AND o.amount = 3539

SELECT d.a2,
       ROUND(((d.a13 - d.a12) / NULLIF(d.a12, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS pct_change
FROM district d
WHERE d.a12 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.a13 IS NOT NULL
  AND d.district_id IN (
      SELECT a.district_id
      FROM account a
      JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
      WHERE l.status = 'D'
  )

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1997 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric
        - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) = 1996 THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)::numeric)

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id

  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.date) IN (1996, 1997)

WITH first_month AS (
    SELECT date_trunc('month', MIN(date)) AS m FROM account
),
d AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT di.district_id, di.a2, CAST(di.a4 AS bigint) AS pop
    FROM account a
    JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN first_month f ON date_trunc('month', a.date) = f.m
)
SELECT a2, pop
FROM d
WHERE pop = (SELECT MAX(pop) FROM d)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
)
AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary, COUNT(*) AS district_count
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.a11
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE LOWER(d.a3) = 'east bohemia'
      AND c.birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01'
      AND c.birth_date <= DATE '1989-12-31'
) t

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11)::numeric, 2)
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'

          SELECT 1

WITH region_totals AS (
    SELECT d.a3 AS region, SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE l.date <= DATE '1995-12-31'

    GROUP BY d.a3
)
SELECT region, total_amount
FROM region_totals
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM region_totals)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt)::numeric, 2) AS avg_loans
FROM (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS cnt
    FROM account a
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
        FROM disp d
        JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
        WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
          AND c.birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01'
    ) o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
) t

WITH top5 AS (
    SELECT district_id, a2
    FROM district
    ORDER BY a4::bigint DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
acc AS (
    SELECT t.district_id, t.a2, COUNT(a.account_id) AS n_accounts
    FROM top5 t
    JOIN account a ON a.district_id = t.district_id
    GROUP BY t.district_id, t.a2
),
ln AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_active
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
res AS (
    SELECT acc.a2,
           COALESCE(ln.total_active, 0)::numeric / acc.n_accounts AS avg_loan
    FROM acc
    LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.district_id = acc.district_id
)
SELECT a2 AS district_name,
       ROUND(avg_loan) AS avg_active_loan_per_account
FROM res
WHERE avg_loan = (SELECT MAX(avg_loan) FROM res)

SELECT ROUND(
    (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN t.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END)
     / SUM(t.amount))::numeric, 2)
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a2 = 'Pisek'
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(t.k_symbol) <> ''

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS household_payments,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(k_symbol) <> '' AND k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS other_purpose_payments

          WHERE d.account_id = t.account_id
            AND c.gender = 'M'
            AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
      )
) x

WITH prach AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.a2 = 'Prachatice'
),
loans AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
cp AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT account) AS n_counterparties
    FROM trans
    WHERE bank IS NOT NULL AND bank <> ''
      AND account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    p.account_id,
    p.date AS account_opening_date,
    l.total_borrowed,
    COALESCE(c.n_counterparties, 0) AS outside_bank_counterparties,
    hd.a2 AS home_district,
    CAST(hd.a4 AS bigint) AS home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(hd.a4 AS bigint) DESC) AS population_rank
FROM prach p
JOIN loans l ON l.account_id = p.account_id
LEFT JOIN cp c ON c.account_id = p.account_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = p.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN district hd ON hd.district_id = cl.district_id
ORDER BY population_rank, p.account_id

WITH x AS (
    SELECT c.type AS card_type,
           d.district_id,
           d.a2 AS district_name,
           CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) AS inhabitants
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp ds ON c.disp_id = ds.disp_id
    JOIN client cl ON ds.client_id = cl.client_id
    JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT x.card_type, x.district_name, x.inhabitants
FROM x
WHERE x.inhabitants = (
    SELECT MIN(x2.inhabitants)
    FROM x x2
    WHERE x2.card_type = x.card_type
)
ORDER BY x.card_type, x.district_name

WITH q AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM card cd WHERE cd.disp_id = d.disp_id)
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = d.account_id)
),
dd AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM q
),
d AS (
    SELECT di.district_id, di.a2, di.a3, di.a4, di.a11, di.a13
    FROM district di
    JOIN dd ON dd.district_id = di.district_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT a3, a2,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::bigint DESC, a2 ASC) AS rn
    FROM d
)
SELECT d.a3 AS region,
       ROUND(AVG(d.a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary,
       ROUND(AVG(d.a13)::numeric, 2) AS avg_unemployment_rate_1996,
       r.a2 AS most_populous_district
FROM d
JOIN ranked r ON r.a3 = d.a3 AND r.rn = 1
GROUP BY d.a3, r.a2

WITH t AS (
    SELECT tr.bank,
           tr.account,
           COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
           SUM(tr.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM trans tr
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = tr.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) >= 250000
      AND tr.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND tr.date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
      AND tr.date <= DATE '1998-12-31'
      AND tr.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND tr.bank <> ''
      AND tr.account IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disp di
          JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = di.disp_id
          WHERE di.account_id = a.account_id
            AND di.type = 'OWNER'
            AND c.type = 'gold'
      )
    GROUP BY tr.bank, tr.account
)
SELECT bank, account, payment_count, total_amount
FROM t
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM t)

WITH gold_accts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id, c.gender
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN disp o ON o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = o.client_id
    WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
      AND a.account_id IN (
          SELECT account_id
          FROM trans
          GROUP BY account_id
          HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000
      )
),
gd AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT g.gender, di.district_id, di.a2 AS district_name,
           di.a4::bigint AS inhabitants, di.a11 AS salary, di.a10 AS urban_ratio
    FROM gold_accts g
    JOIN district di ON di.district_id = g.district_id
    WHERE di.a4::bigint > 100000
),
st AS (
    SELECT gender,
           COUNT(*) AS district_count,
           ROUND(AVG(salary)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio)::numeric, 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
    FROM gd
    GROUP BY gender
),
mx AS (
    SELECT gender, MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inh
    FROM gd
    GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT gd.gender,
       st.district_count,
       gd.district_name,
       gd.inhabitants,
       st.avg_salary,
       st.avg_urban_ratio
FROM gd
JOIN mx ON mx.gender = gd.gender AND mx.max_inh = gd.inhabitants
JOIN st ON st.gender = gd.gender
ORDER BY CASE WHEN gd.gender = 'F' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, gd.district_name

WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT a2, a16, a4::bigint AS pop
    FROM district
    WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia'
    ORDER BY a4::bigint DESC,
             translate(a2,
                       'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýžÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ',
                       'acdeeinorstuuyzACDEEINORSTUUYZ') ASC
    LIMIT 3
),
avg3 AS (
    SELECT AVG(a16)::numeric AS avg_three FROM top3
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(a16)::numeric AS avg_all FROM district
)
SELECT t.a2 AS district_name,
       t.a16 AS crimes_1996,
       ROUND(a3.avg_three, 2) AS avg_three_districts,
       ROUND(o.avg_all, 2) AS avg_all_districts,
       ROUND(a3.avg_three - o.avg_all, 2) AS difference
FROM top3 t
CROSS JOIN avg3 a3
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY t.pop DESC,
         translate(t.a2,
                   'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýžÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ',
                   'acdeeinorstuuyzACDEEINORSTUUYZ') ASC

WITH reg AS (
    SELECT district_id, a2
    FROM district
    WHERE a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM district WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice')
),
acc AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, r.a2 AS district_name
    FROM account a
    JOIN reg r ON r.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE a.date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
lastbal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.account_id) t.account_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN acc ON acc.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    ORDER BY t.account_id, t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
),
x AS (
    SELECT acc.district_name, acc.account_id, lb.balance
    FROM acc
    LEFT JOIN lastbal lb ON lb.account_id = acc.account_id
),
d AS (
    SELECT district_name,
           COUNT(*) AS num_accounts,
           AVG(balance) AS avg_raw
    FROM x
    GROUP BY district_name
)
SELECT d.district_name,
       d.num_accounts,
       ROUND(d.avg_raw::numeric, 2) AS avg_end_1996_balance,
       (SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance)::numeric, 2) FROM x) AS region_avg_end_1996_balance,
       (SELECT district_name FROM d ORDER BY avg_raw DESC NULLS LAST, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) AS top_district
FROM d
ORDER BY d.district_name

WITH acc_loan AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           a.district_id,
           to_char(a.date, 'YYYY') AS yr,
           COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS lent
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia'
      AND a.date >= DATE '1996-01-01'
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, to_char(a.date, 'YYYY')
),
dist AS (
    SELECT yr,
           district_id,
           COUNT(*) AS n_accounts,
           SUM(lent) AS lent,
           SUM(lent)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS per_account
    FROM acc_loan
    GROUP BY yr, district_id
)
SELECT yr AS account_year,
       SUM(n_accounts) AS number_of_accounts,
       SUM(lent) AS total_amount_lent,
       ROUND(AVG(per_account), 2) AS avg_lent_per_account_across_districts
FROM dist
GROUP BY yr
ORDER BY yr

WITH top_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 10
),
dists AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.a2, d.a4::bigint AS inhabitants, d.a11
    FROM top_loans t
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = t.district_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT a2 FROM dists ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS district_name,
    (SELECT inhabitants FROM dists ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS inhabitants,
    (SELECT ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2) FROM dists) AS avg_salary

WITH w AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
o AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(od.amount) AS total_orders
    FROM "order" od
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = od.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
ac AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS n_accounts
    FROM account
    GROUP BY district_id
)
SELECT
    d.a2 AS district_name,
    d.a3 AS region,
    d.a4::bigint AS population,
    w.total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(w.total_withdrawn::numeric / d.a4::bigint, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY w.total_withdrawn::numeric / d.a4::bigint DESC) AS withdrawal_rank,
    ROUND(COALESCE(o.total_orders, 0)::numeric / ac.n_accounts, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM district d
JOIN w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN ac ON ac.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN o ON o.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a4::bigint >= 100000
ORDER BY withdrawal_rank, district_name

WITH top_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.date, a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
    ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.date ASC, l.loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT d.a2 AS district,
       t.amount,
       t.date AS approval_date,
       tr.balance
FROM top_loans t
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = t.district_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT x.balance
    FROM trans x
    WHERE x.account_id = t.account_id
      AND x.date <= t.date
    ORDER BY x.date DESC, x.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) tr ON TRUE
ORDER BY t.amount DESC, t.date ASC, t.loan_id ASC

SELECT d.a2 AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.a3 = 'north Moravia'
  AND t.date <= DATE '1998-10-14'
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '')
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, d.a2 ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')

SELECT t.bank AS bank_code,
       t.account AS account_number,
       COUNT(*) AS num_payments,
       SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
FROM trans t
WHERE t.account_id IN (
        SELECT l.account_id
        FROM loan l
        WHERE l.amount = 98832
          AND l.date = '1996-01-03'
      )
  AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  AND t.date < '1996-01-03'
  AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
  AND t.bank <> ''
  AND t.account IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
ORDER BY total_amount DESC

WITH acc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    WHERE d.client_id = 3541
),
dist AS (
    SELECT district_id, a2, a3, CAST(a4 AS bigint) AS pop, a11,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS bigint) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM district
),
top_d AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (a3) a3, a2 AS top_name, CAST(a4 AS bigint) AS top_pop
    FROM district
    ORDER BY a3, CAST(a4 AS bigint) DESC, district_id
),
region_clients AS (
    SELECT d.a3, COUNT(*) AS client_cnt
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.a3
),
t AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS n_trans,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       a.date AS account_open_date,
       a.frequency,
       ds.a2 AS district_name,
       ds.a3 AS region,
       CASE WHEN a.district_id = cl.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
       ds.a11 AS average_salary,
       COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
       COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
       COALESCE(t.n_trans, 0) AS num_transactions,
       COALESCE(t.income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(t.expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(t.income, 0) - COALESCE(t.expense, 0) AS net_balance,
       COALESCE(rc.client_cnt, 0) AS clients_in_region,
       td.top_name AS most_populous_district,
       td.top_pop AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
       ds.rnk AS population_rank_in_region
FROM acc
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = acc.account_id
JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = 3541
JOIN dist ds ON ds.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_clients rc ON rc.a3 = ds.a3
LEFT JOIN top_d td ON td.a3 = ds.a3
ORDER BY num_transactions DESC, a.account_id ASC

SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_accounts,
       COUNT(*) AS num_districts,
       ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary
FROM (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.a11, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= DATE '1997-01-01'
      AND a.date < DATE '1998-01-01'
      AND d.a4::bigint >= 100000
    GROUP BY d.district_id, d.a11
) t

SELECT
    cl.client_id,
    cl.gender,
    cl.birth_date,
    c.type AS card_type,
    (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.birth_date))::int AS age_at_issue,
    COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) AS number_of_loans,
    COALESCE(l.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount_borrowed,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) > 0
             AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.birth_date)) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
        WHEN COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) > 0
             AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.birth_date)) >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
        ELSE 'Non-borrower'
    END AS borrower_classification,
    d.a2 AS district_name,
    d.a11 AS district_average_salary,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY cl.gender
        ORDER BY (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cl.birth_date))
    ) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM card c
JOIN disp dp ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
JOIN client cl ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) l ON l.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND c.issued < DATE '1995-01-01'
ORDER BY cl.client_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN TRIM(k_symbol) = 'UROK' THEN amount
                         WHEN TRIM(k_symbol) = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -amount
                         ELSE 0 END), 0) AS net_interest
FROM trans
WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = 2823)
  AND date >= DATE '1998-01-01'
  AND date <= DATE '1998-12-31'

WITH d AS (
    SELECT di.district_id,
           di.a3 AS region,
           CAST(di.a4 AS bigint) AS pop,
           COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS n_acc
    FROM account a
    JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE l.duration > 24
      AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
    GROUP BY di.district_id, di.a3, di.a4
)
SELECT region,
       COUNT(*) AS num_districts,
       SUM(pop) AS total_population,
       SUM(n_acc) AS num_accounts
FROM d
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY SUM(pop) DESC, region ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11)::numeric, 2)
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT a.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < DATE '1930-01-01'
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.a11)::numeric, 2)
FROM district d
WHERE d.district_id IN (
    SELECT c.district_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
      AND c.birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01'
)

WITH gold AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
t AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bank IS NOT NULL AND bank <> '' AND account IS NOT NULL
                               THEN bank || '-' || CAST(account AS text) END) AS ext_counterparties
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
l AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT g.account_id,
       di.a2 AS district_name,
       di.a3 AS region,
       COALESCE(t.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
       COALESCE(t.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
       COALESCE(l.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(t.ext_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(t.ext_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS rank
FROM gold g
JOIN account a ON g.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
LEFT JOIN t ON g.account_id = t.account_id
LEFT JOIN l ON g.account_id = l.account_id
ORDER BY rank, g.account_id

WITH female_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id,
           c.client_id,
           l.account_id,
           l.amount,
           l.duration,
           l.payments,
           l.status,
           c.birth_date,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.amount DESC) AS rnk
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = l.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
trans_summary AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
           COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
region_loans AS (
    SELECT d.a3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS loans_in_region
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.a3
),
region_salary AS (
    SELECT a3 AS region, ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY a3
)
SELECT fl.client_id,
       ROUND(fl.amount::numeric, 2) AS loan_amount,
       fl.duration AS duration_months,
       ROUND((fl.payments::numeric * fl.duration), 2) AS total_payments,
       ROUND((fl.payments::numeric * fl.duration - fl.amount), 2) AS interest_paid,
       fl.status AS loan_status,
       d.a2 AS district,
       d.a3 AS region,
       COALESCE(ts.trans_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       ROUND(COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0)::numeric, 2) AS total_deposits,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * fl.amount THEN 'High Income'
            WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_deposits, 0) > fl.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
            ELSE 'Low Income' END AS income_category,
       rl.loans_in_region,
       rs.avg_salary AS region_avg_salary,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', fl.birth_date))::int AS client_age
FROM female_loans fl
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = fl.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans_summary ts ON ts.account_id = fl.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_loans rl ON rl.region = d.a3
LEFT JOIN region_salary rs ON rs.region = d.a3
WHERE fl.rnk <= 3
ORDER BY fl.amount DESC, fl.loan_id

SELECT ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2)
FROM district
WHERE district_id IN (
    SELECT a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'C' AND l.amount < 100000
)

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.positionorder <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND ra.year >= 2010

SELECT ROUND(
  (
    (MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceid = 853 THEN CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS numeric) END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceid = 854 THEN CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS numeric) END))
    / MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceid = 854 THEN CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS numeric) END) * 100
  )::numeric, 2
) AS percentage_difference
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
WHERE d.forename = 'Paul'
  AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
  AND r.raceid IN (853, 854)

WITH top_driver AS (
    SELECT driverid, COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM results
    WHERE positionorder = 1
    GROUP BY driverid
    ORDER BY wins DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, MAX(ds.points) AS max_points
FROM top_driver t
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = t.driverid
JOIN driverstandings ds ON ds.driverid = d.driverid
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality

SELECT cohort, ROUND(AVG(d.a11)) AS avg_salary
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE WHEN c.birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' THEN 'young' ELSE 'old' END AS cohort,
        a.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    WHERE c.birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01'
       OR c.birth_date < DATE '1920-01-01'
) x
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = x.district_id
GROUP BY cohort
ORDER BY CASE WHEN cohort = 'young' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

WITH acc AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.a2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
owner AS (
    SELECT di.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM disp di
    JOIN client c ON c.client_id = di.client_id
    WHERE di.type = 'OWNER'
),
cards AS (
    SELECT di.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_cnt
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp di ON di.disp_id = cd.disp_id
    WHERE cd.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY di.account_id
),
loans AS (
    SELECT l.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_cnt,
           BOOL_OR(l.status = 'B') AS has_b,
           BOOL_OR(l.status IN ('C','D')) AS has_cd
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
tx AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS tx_cnt,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ','VYBER') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
           MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND t.date <= DATE '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT acc.account_id,
       acc.date AS opened_date,
       o.gender,
       DATE_PART('year', AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date))::int AS age,
       COALESCE(cards.card_cnt, 0) AS num_cards,
       COALESCE(loans.loan_cnt, 0) AS num_loans,
       CASE
           WHEN loans.loan_cnt IS NULL THEN 'no loan'
           WHEN loans.has_b THEN 'defaulted'
           WHEN loans.has_cd THEN 'repaying'
           ELSE 'paid off'
       END AS loan_standing,
       COALESCE(tx.tx_cnt, 0) AS num_transactions_1997,
       COALESCE(tx.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997,
       COALESCE(tx.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997,
       COALESCE(tx.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance_1997,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(tx.peak_balance, 0) DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM acc
LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN cards ON cards.account_id = acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans ON loans.account_id = acc.account_id
LEFT JOIN tx ON tx.account_id = acc.account_id
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, acc.account_id

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.dob < DATE '1985-01-01' AND r.laps > 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceid = ra.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005

SELECT SUM(cr.points) AS score, c.name, c.nationality
FROM constructorresults cr
JOIN races r ON cr.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorid = c.constructorid
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorid, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ra.year,
       ROUND(AVG(r.milliseconds::numeric) / 1000.0, 2) AS mean_winner_time_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE r.position = 1
  AND r.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  AND ra.year < 1975
GROUP BY ra.year
ORDER BY ra.year

WITH q AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM card c
          WHERE c.disp_id = d.disp_id AND c.type = 'classic'
      )
),
cl AS (
    SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS n_clients
    FROM q
    GROUP BY district_id
),
pay AS (
    SELECT q.district_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT (t.bank, t.account)) AS n_ext,
           SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
    FROM q
    JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = q.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> ''
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY q.district_id
)
SELECT di.a2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(cl.n_clients, 0) AS number_of_clients,
       COALESCE(pay.n_ext, 0) AS number_of_external_accounts,
       COALESCE(pay.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount_paid
FROM district di
LEFT JOIN cl ON cl.district_id = di.district_id
LEFT JOIN pay ON pay.district_id = di.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC, district_name ASC

WITH winner AS (
    SELECT raceid, laps
    FROM results
    WHERE position = 1
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.laps = w.laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN winner w ON w.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND r.year = 2008
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH r AS (
    SELECT res.positionorder, res.milliseconds, res.laps
    FROM results res
    JOIN races ra ON ra.raceid = res.raceid
    WHERE ra.year = 1988
      AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
w AS (
    SELECT milliseconds, laps
    FROM r
    WHERE positionorder = 1
),
l AS (
    SELECT MAX(r.milliseconds) AS milliseconds
    FROM r, w
    WHERE r.laps = w.laps
      AND r.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(((l.milliseconds - w.milliseconds)::numeric / l.milliseconds) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM w, l

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM laptimes l
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = l.driverid
WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY MIN(l.milliseconds) ASC
LIMIT 20

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob, COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_count
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN qualifying q
  ON q.driverid = d.driverid
 AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
 AND q.q3 <> ''
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.dob) BETWEEN 1971 AND 1985
GROUP BY d.driverid, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
ORDER BY q3_count DESC, d.dob ASC

SELECT c.name,
       (m.min_ms / 60000)::text || ':' ||
       lpad(((m.min_ms % 60000) / 1000)::text, 2, '0') || '.' ||
       lpad((m.min_ms % 1000)::text, 3, '0') AS fastest_lap_time
FROM (
    SELECT r.circuitid, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS min_ms
    FROM laptimes l
    JOIN races r ON r.raceid = l.raceid
    WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY r.circuitid
) m
JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitid = m.circuitid
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(p.raceid)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceid), 2) AS avg_pit_stops_per_race
FROM races r
LEFT JOIN pitstops p ON p.raceid = r.raceid
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM races WHERE year = 2000)

WITH t AS (
    SELECT q.driverid,
           (split_part(q.q1, ':', 1)::int * 60 + split_part(q.q1, ':', 2)::numeric) AS secs
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN races r ON r.raceid = q.raceid
    WHERE r.year = 1995
      AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q1 <> ''
)
SELECT d.nationality
FROM t
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = t.driverid
WHERE t.secs = (SELECT MAX(secs) FROM t)

WITH q AS (
    SELECT d.driverref,
           d.nationality,
           d.dob,
           qu.q1,
           (split_part(qu.q1, ':', 1)::int * 60000
            + split_part(qu.q1, ':', 2)::numeric * 1000) AS ms
    FROM qualifying qu
    JOIN races r ON r.raceid = qu.raceid
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = qu.driverid
    WHERE r.year = 1995
      AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
      AND qu.q1 ~ '^\d+:\d+\.\d+$'
)
SELECT driverref, nationality, dob, q1
FROM q
WHERE ms = (SELECT MAX(ms) FROM q)

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q1
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverid = d.driverid
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 ~ '^\d+:\d+\.\d+$'
  AND q.q1 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2.q1)
    FROM qualifying q2
    WHERE q2.raceid = r.raceid
      AND q2.q1 ~ '^\d+:\d+\.\d+$'
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q2.driverid)
FROM qualifying q1
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = q1.driverid
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = q1.raceid
JOIN qualifying q2 ON q2.raceid = q1.raceid AND q2.driverid <> q1.driverid
WHERE d.forename = 'Lucas'
  AND d.surname = 'di Grassi'
  AND r.year = 2010
  AND q1.position IS NOT NULL
  AND q2.position IS NOT NULL
  AND q1.position < q2.position

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) AS runner_up_count
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = r.driverid
WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND r.positionorder = 2
GROUP BY d.forename
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid) >= 2
ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, d.forename ASC

WITH q AS (
    SELECT d.nationality,
           (split_part(ql.q2, ':', 1)::int * 60000 + round(split_part(ql.q2, ':', 2)::numeric * 1000)) AS ms
    FROM qualifying ql
    JOIN races r ON r.raceid = ql.raceid
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = ql.driverid
    WHERE r.year = 2017
      AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND ql.q2 IS NOT NULL
      AND ql.q2 <> ''
)
SELECT nationality
FROM q
WHERE ms = (SELECT MIN(ms) FROM q)

SELECT d.driverref, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = q.raceid
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = q.driverid
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q2) <> ''
  AND q.q2 <> '\N'
  AND (q.q3 IS NULL OR TRIM(q.q3) = '' OR q.q3 = '\N')

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(q.q3)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverid), 2)
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN qualifying q
  ON q.driverid = d.driverid
 AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
 AND q.q3 <> ''
WHERE d.dob >= DATE '1981-01-01'
  AND d.dob <= DATE '1991-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverid)
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceid = q.raceid
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> ''
  AND q.q2 < '1:40.000'

SELECT c.name, c.location, c.country, r.year, p.duration
FROM pitstops p
JOIN races r ON p.raceid = r.raceid
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitid = c.circuitid
