SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mj.college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS in_college,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mj.college IS DISTINCT FROM 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS not_in_college
FROM member me
LEFT JOIN major mj ON me.link_to_major = mj.major_id

WITH ev AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, MAX(b.amount) AS max_amt
    FROM expense x
    JOIN budget b ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE x.expense_description ILIKE '%chips%'
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
)
SELECT event_name
FROM ev
WHERE max_amt = (SELECT MAX(max_amt) FROM ev)

WITH vp AS (
    SELECT e.expense_date, e.cost
    FROM expense e
    JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
    WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'
)
SELECT expense_date, SUM(cost::numeric) AS total_cost
FROM vp
WHERE expense_date = (SELECT MAX(expense_date) FROM vp)
GROUP BY expense_date

SELECT e.event_name,
       ROUND(COALESCE(w.water_spent, 0)::numeric / a.attendee_count, 2) AS water_cost_per_attendee
FROM event e
JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(x.cost) AS water_spent
    FROM expense x
    JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = x.link_to_budget
    WHERE x.expense_description ILIKE '%water%'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event
) w ON w.link_to_event = e.event_id

WITH c AS (
    SELECT mj.college, COUNT(DISTINCT mj.major_id) AS major_count
    FROM member me
    JOIN major mj ON me.link_to_major = mj.major_id
    GROUP BY mj.college
)
SELECT college, major_count
FROM c
WHERE major_count = (SELECT MAX(major_count) FROM c)
ORDER BY college

SELECT e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT x.expense_description) AS num_items
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE e.event_id IN (
    SELECT link_to_event FROM budget WHERE amount > 40
)
GROUP BY e.location

SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budgeted
FROM budget b
WHERE b.link_to_event IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.event_id
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b2 ON b2.link_to_event = e.event_id
    JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b2.budget_id
    WHERE x.expense_description = 'Pizza'
      AND e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
      AND e.event_date < '2019-10-01'
)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::numeric, 2) AS average_spent_per_event
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id, COALESCE(SUM(b.spent), 0) AS event_total
    FROM event e
    LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
) t

WITH type_counts AS (
    SELECT e.type, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
    WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
      AND e.event_date < '2020-06-01'
    GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT type, member_count
FROM type_counts
WHERE member_count = (SELECT MAX(member_count) FROM type_counts)

SELECT e.event_name,
       e.event_date,
       COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0) AS total_budget,
       COALESCE(a.attendee_count, 0) AS attendee_count
FROM event e
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budget
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
) a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
ORDER BY e.event_name ASC, e.event_date ASC

WITH b AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS total_budget, SUM(spent) AS total_spent
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
p AS (
    SELECT bu.link_to_event,
           SUM(
               CASE
                   WHEN ex.expense_description IS NULL OR TRIM(ex.expense_description) = '' THEN 0
                   ELSE LENGTH(ex.expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE(ex.expense_description, ',', '')) + 1
               END
           ) AS purchases
    FROM expense ex
    JOIN budget bu ON ex.link_to_budget = bu.budget_id
    GROUP BY bu.link_to_event
)
SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
LEFT JOIN b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN p ON p.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
  AND COALESCE(b.total_spent, 0) <= COALESCE(b.total_budget, 0)
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.purchases, 0) DESC, e.event_id ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT item, COUNT(DISTINCT expense_id) AS record_count
FROM (
    SELECT e.expense_id, trim(x.item) AS item
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(e.expense_description, ',') AS x(item)
    WHERE b.category = 'Food'
) t
WHERE item <> ''
GROUP BY item
ORDER BY record_count DESC, item ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.major_id)
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE m.department ILIKE '%Political Science%'

WITH items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        e.expense_id,
        trim(x.item) AS item,
        b.category,
        e.cost::numeric AS cost
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(e.expense_description, ',') AS x(item)
    WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
      AND e.approved = 'true'
      AND trim(x.item) <> ''
)
SELECT item, category, SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM items
GROUP BY category, item
ORDER BY category, item

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'

SELECT c.colour,
       COUNT(*) AS hero_count,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND c.colour <> 'No Colour'
GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, c.colour ASC

WITH exp AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
),
items AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member,
           COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(item))) AS kinds
    FROM exp e,
         UNNEST(STRING_TO_ARRAY(e.expense_description, ',')) AS item
    WHERE TRIM(item) <> ''
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member
),
spend AS (
    SELECT link_to_member,
           SUM(cost) AS total_spent
    FROM exp
    GROUP BY link_to_member
)
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       i.kinds AS kinds_of_items,
       s.total_spent
FROM items i
JOIN spend s ON s.link_to_member = i.link_to_member
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
WHERE i.kinds = (SELECT MAX(kinds) FROM items)

SELECT t.item, COUNT(*) AS times_bought
FROM (
    SELECT TRIM(s.item) AS item
    FROM expense e
    JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL regexp_split_to_table(e.expense_description, ',') AS s(item)
    WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha'
      AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
) t
WHERE t.item <> ''
GROUP BY t.item

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS neutral_percentage,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Neutral' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neutral_marvel_count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT p.publisher_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics')
    GROUP BY p.publisher_name
)
SELECT publisher_name,
       cnt - MIN(cnt) OVER () AS difference
FROM counts
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'No Colour'
  AND s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190

SELECT ROUND(
    (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*))::numeric,
    2
) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
    FROM hero_attribute ha2
    JOIN attribute a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
    WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
  , 2) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN dc > marvel THEN 'DC Comics'
        WHEN marvel > dc THEN 'Marvel Comics'
        ELSE 'Tie'
    END AS publisher,
    ABS(dc - marvel) AS difference
FROM counts

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)::numeric, 1)
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg > 0

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE s.eye_colour_id = s.hair_colour_id
  AND s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id
  AND c.colour <> 'No Colour'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment IS NULL OR a.alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad')

WITH ss AS (
    SELECT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT power_id
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY power_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hero_id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM ss)) = 0
) t

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS avg_height_cm
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND s.height_cm > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM hero_power hp2
        JOIN superhero s2 ON s2.id = hp2.hero_id
        JOIN publisher p2 ON p2.id = s2.publisher_id
        WHERE p2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
          AND hp2.power_id = hp.power_id
      )
  )

WITH counts AS (
    SELECT sp.power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-'
    GROUP BY sp.power_name
)
SELECT power_name, hero_count
FROM counts
WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM counts)

SELECT g.gender, COUNT(h.id) AS hero_count
FROM gender g
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT s.id, s.gender_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.hair_colour_id
    JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE c.colour = 'Blue'
    GROUP BY s.id, s.gender_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) >= 10
) h ON h.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
GROUP BY g.gender

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)::numeric, 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
        SELECT ha2.attribute_value
        FROM superhero s2
        JOIN hero_attribute ha2 ON ha2.hero_id = s2.id
        JOIN attribute a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
        WHERE s2.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
          AND a2.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
        LIMIT 1
  )
  AND s.weight_kg > 0

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS rnk
    FROM superhero
    WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id)
FROM ranked r
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = r.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE r.rnk <= 10

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg))::int AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
        SELECT ha2.attribute_value
        FROM hero_attribute ha2
        JOIN superhero s2 ON s2.id = ha2.hero_id
        JOIN attribute a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
        WHERE s2.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
          AND a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
        LIMIT 1
  )
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg > 0

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.publisher_id = (SELECT publisher_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' LIMIT 1)
  AND (r.race = '-' OR s.race_id IS NULL)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt)::numeric, 2) AS avg_superpowers
FROM (
    SELECT s.id, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS cnt
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
    JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
    LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE r.race = 'God / Eternal'
      AND g.gender = 'Male'
    GROUP BY s.id
) t

SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm)::numeric, 1)
FROM superhero
WHERE race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb')
  AND height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND height_cm > 0

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS avg_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM superhero m
    JOIN publisher mp ON m.publisher_id = mp.id
    WHERE mp.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND m.eye_colour_id = s.eye_colour_id
  )

WITH cryo_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE sp.power_name = 'Cryokinesis'
),
cryo_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN cryo_heroes c ON c.hero_id = hp.hero_id
),
related_heroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN cryo_powers cp ON cp.power_id = hp.power_id
),
counts AS (
    SELECT r.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS n
    FROM related_heroes r
    JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = r.hero_id
    GROUP BY r.hero_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(n)::numeric, 1) AS avg_powers
FROM counts

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND p.publisher_name IS DISTINCT FROM 'DC Comics'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm > 200
  AND p.publisher_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(p.publisher_name) <> ''

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 1) AS average_weight_kg,
       COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg > 0

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg)
FROM superhero s
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.race_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM superhero f
    JOIN gender g ON g.id = f.gender_id
    WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
      AND f.race_id = s.race_id
  )

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
WHERE s.publisher_id = (SELECT publisher_id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' LIMIT 1)
  AND s.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM superhero o
    WHERE o.eye_colour_id = s.eye_colour_id
      AND o.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
      AND o.publisher_id <> s.publisher_id
  )

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)::numeric, 2)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg > 0

WITH pub AS (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
),
counts AS (
    SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
    WHERE s.publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM pub)
      AND r.race IS NOT NULL
      AND r.race <> '-'
    GROUP BY r.race
)
SELECT race, cnt
FROM counts
WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM counts)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ha.attribute_value)::numeric, 1) AS avg_intelligence
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE LOWER(a.attribute_name) = 'intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL
  AND ha.hero_id IN (
    SELECT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE LOWER(sp.power_name) IN ('super speed', 'death touch')
  )

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm)::numeric, 1)
FROM superhero s
WHERE s.superhero_name <> '3-D Man'
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND s.height_cm > 0
  AND s.id IN (
    SELECT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.power_id IN (
      SELECT hp2.power_id
      FROM hero_power hp2
      JOIN superhero s2 ON s2.id = hp2.hero_id
      WHERE s2.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
    )
  )

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm) FILTER (WHERE s.height_cm > 0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_height_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE s.weight_kg > 0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND a.alignment = 'Bad'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND s.weight_kg > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power hp
    JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
      AND sp.power_name = 'Flight'
  )

WITH h AS (
    SELECT s.id,
           g.gender,
           (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id) AS cnt
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id
    WHERE g.gender IN ('Male', 'Female')
      AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(s.full_name) ~ '\S+\s+\S+'
)
SELECT
    ROUND((AVG(cnt) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'Male'))::numeric, 2) AS male_avg_powers,
    ROUND((AVG(cnt) FILTER (WHERE gender = 'Female'))::numeric, 2) AS female_avg_powers
FROM h

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)::numeric, 2)
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id)

SELECT
    ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm) FILTER (WHERE s.height_cm > 0)::numeric, 1) AS avg_height_cm,
    ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE s.weight_kg > 0)::numeric, 1) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg > 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.weight_kg > 0
  AND s.weight_kg < 70

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''

SELECT s.superhero_name, s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  )
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-'

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE r.race = 'Human'
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  AND s.height_cm = (
    SELECT MIN(s2.height_cm)
    FROM superhero s2
    JOIN race r2 ON s2.race_id = r2.id
    WHERE r2.race = 'Human'
      AND s2.height_cm IS NOT NULL
  )

WITH lightest AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg > 0)
)
SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_superpowers
FROM (
    SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.power_name) AS cnt
    FROM lightest l
    LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = l.id
    LEFT JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    GROUP BY l.id
) t

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour,
       (SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM superhero s2
        LEFT JOIN colour hc ON hc.id = s2.hair_colour_id
        WHERE s2.eye_colour_id = c.id
          AND (hc.colour IS DISTINCT FROM 'Brown')) AS hero_count
FROM colour c
WHERE c.id IN (
    SELECT s.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN colour h ON h.id = s.hair_colour_id
    WHERE h.colour = 'Brown'
)
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC

SELECT ROUND(
  (100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN s.id END)
   / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id))::numeric, 2)
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id)

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric
    / COUNT(*)::numeric, 2) AS good_percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '-'

WITH hi AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.sex
    FROM patient p
    JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
    WHERE (p.sex = 'M' AND l.ua > 8.0)
       OR (p.sex = 'F' AND l.ua > 6.5)
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'M') AS NUMERIC)
       / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F'), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM hi

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)::numeric, 2)
FROM superhero s
WHERE s.id <> (SELECT id FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = '3-D Man')
  AND s.weight_kg > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
      AND hp.power_id IN (
        SELECT hp2.power_id
        FROM hero_power hp2
        JOIN superhero d ON d.id = hp2.hero_id
        WHERE d.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
      )
  )

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.alb)::numeric, 4)
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.plt > 400
  AND p.sex = 'F'
  AND p.diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.tg >= 200
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', p.birthday)) > 50

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.colour = 'Blue') AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL OR s.weight_kg = 0

SELECT p.id,
       p.sex,
       date_part('year', age(DATE '2026-10-09', p.birthday))::int AS age
FROM patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.glu >= 180
      AND l."T-CHO" < 250
)

SELECT p.id,
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', p.birthday))::int AS age
FROM patient p
JOIN (
    SELECT id
    FROM laboratory
    WHERE hct >= 52
    GROUP BY id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
) l ON l.id = p.id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.crp = '+'
  AND p.description IS NULL

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.sex = 'F') / COUNT(*), 2)
FROM patient p
WHERE p.birthday < (DATE '2026-10-09' - INTERVAL '55 years')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.pt >= 14
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.sc170 IN ('negative', '0')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM examination e
    WHERE e.id = p.id
      AND e.symptoms IS NOT NULL
  )

SELECT ROUND(
  (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2
) AS percentage
FROM patient p
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday) BETWEEN 1930 AND 1940
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM laboratory l WHERE l.id = p.id)

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS patient_count
FROM patient p
WHERE p.birthday > DATE '1960-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.rnp IS NOT NULL
      AND (CASE WHEN trim(l.rnp) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
                THEN trim(l.rnp)::numeric
                ELSE NULL END) > 10
  )

SELECT sex, ROUND(AVG(cnt)::numeric, 2) AS avg_lab_dates
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.sex, COUNT(l.date) AS cnt
    FROM patient p
    LEFT JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM examination e WHERE e.id = p.id)
      AND p.sex IN ('F', 'M')
    GROUP BY p.id, p.sex
) t
GROUP BY sex
ORDER BY sex

WITH numeric_rnp AS (
    SELECT l.id,
           l."date",
           l."T-BIL",
           CASE WHEN trim(l.rnp) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(l.rnp)::numeric END AS rnp_val
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.rnp IS NOT NULL
),
top_rnp AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM numeric_rnp
    WHERE rnp_val IS NOT NULL
      AND rnp_val = (SELECT MAX(rnp_val) FROM numeric_rnp)
)
SELECT t."T-BIL", t."date", t.id, p.sex, p.birthday
FROM top_rnp t
JOIN patient p ON p.id = t.id
WHERE t."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM top_rnp)

SELECT p.admission, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE CASE WHEN l.rnp ~ '^\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$' THEN l.rnp::numeric END > 16
  AND p.admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY p.admission

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM patient p
WHERE p.diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.id = p.id
      AND CASE
            WHEN trim(l2.rnp) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(l2.rnp)::numeric > 5
            ELSE false
          END
  )

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT p.id
    FROM patient p
    WHERE TRIM(p.admission) = '-'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM laboratory l
          WHERE l.id = p.id
            AND l.ssa IS NOT NULL
            AND l.ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')
      )
),
rnp_vals AS (
    SELECT l.id, l.rnp::numeric AS titer
    FROM laboratory l
    JOIN eligible e ON e.id = l.id
    WHERE l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
),
patient_max AS (
    SELECT id, MAX(titer) AS titer
    FROM rnp_vals
    GROUP BY id
)
SELECT id, titer
FROM patient_max
WHERE titer = (SELECT MAX(titer) FROM patient_max)

WITH f AS (
    SELECT l.id,
           l.date,
           CASE WHEN trim(l.dna) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(l.dna)::numeric END AS lvl
    FROM laboratory l
    JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
    WHERE p.sex = 'F'
      AND p.admission = '+'
)
SELECT id, date, lvl
FROM f
WHERE lvl = (SELECT MAX(lvl) FROM f)
ORDER BY id

SELECT MAX(CAST(l.rnp AS NUMERIC)) AS highest_rnp
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.admission = '-'
  AND l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'

SELECT p.sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE l.alb < 3.5
  AND p.sex IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.sex

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM patient p
WHERE TRIM(p.admission) = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.hct IS NOT NULL
      AND (l.hct <= 29 OR l.hct >= 52)
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l2
    WHERE l2.id = p.id
      AND l2.rnp IS NOT NULL
      AND (CASE WHEN TRIM(l2.rnp) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
                THEN CAST(TRIM(l2.rnp) AS numeric)
                ELSE NULL END) > 16
  )

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage
FROM patient
WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%PSA%' OR diagnosis ILIKE '%psoria%'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.tp::numeric - 8.5), 3) AS avg_tp_deviation
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND l.tp > 8.5
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM examination e
    WHERE e.id = l.id
      AND e.diagnosis ~ '(^|,)\s*SLE\s*(,|$)'
  )

WITH items AS (
    SELECT p.id, UPPER(TRIM(x)) AS d
    FROM patient p,
         UNNEST(string_to_array(p.diagnosis, ',')) AS x
    WHERE TRIM(x) <> ''
      AND x NOT ILIKE '%susp%'
),
cand AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM items
    GROUP BY id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d) = 2
       AND bool_and(d IN ('RA', 'SJS'))
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM laboratory l
        WHERE l.id = c.id AND l.plt > 100 AND l.plt < 400
    )) AS with_normal_platelet,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM laboratory l
        WHERE l.id = c.id AND l.plt > 100 AND l.plt < 400
    )) AS never_normal_platelet
FROM cand c

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' THEN p.id END) AS women,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.sex = 'M' THEN p.id END) AS men
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE CASE WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN l.rnp::numeric END > 32

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM laboratory l
   JOIN patient p ON l.id = p.id
   WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSA') AS total_lab_tests,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM patient p
   WHERE p.diagnosis = 'PSA'
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM laboratory l WHERE l.id = p.id)) AS patients_without_lab_tests

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l."date")::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p."birthday")::int) AS youngest_age
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p ON p."id" = l."id"
WHERE CASE WHEN l."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN l."rnp"::numeric END >= 64
  AND p."birthday" IS NOT NULL

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.birthday)) AS avg_age
FROM patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND (
            TRIM(l."U-PRO") IN ('3+', '4+', '3', '4')
         OR (
              regexp_replace(l."U-PRO", '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
              AND CAST(regexp_replace(l."U-PRO", '[^0-9.]', '', 'g') AS numeric) >= 300
            )
          )
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e."id")
FROM "examination" e
WHERE e."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND e."thrombosis" > 0

WITH r AS (
    SELECT l.id,
           MAX(
               CASE
                   WHEN l.rnp ~ '^\s*(1:)?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$' THEN
                       CASE
                           WHEN CAST(regexp_replace(l.rnp, '^\s*1:|\s', '', 'g') AS numeric) > 64 THEN 1
                           ELSE 0
                       END
                   ELSE 0
               END
           ) AS elev
    FROM laboratory l
    JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
    WHERE p.sex = 'F'
      AND l.rnp IS NOT NULL
      AND trim(l.rnp) <> ''
    GROUP BY l.id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(elev) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM r

SELECT ROUND(AVG(e.first_exam - p."First Date")) AS avg_delay_days
FROM patient p
JOIN (
    SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS first_exam
    FROM examination
    GROUP BY id
) e ON e.id = p.id
WHERE p.admission LIKE '%+%'

SELECT p.sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
WHERE l.got < 60
  AND l.date >= DATE '1994-01-01'
  AND l.date <= DATE '1994-12-31'
  AND p.sex IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.sex
ORDER BY p.sex

SELECT e.symptoms
FROM examination e
JOIN patient p ON p.id = e.id
WHERE p."diagnosis" ~ '\mSLE\M'
  AND e.thrombosis > 0
  AND e.symptoms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY e.symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, e.symptoms ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.sex = 'F' THEN p.id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.sex = 'M' THEN p.id END) AS diff
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.un < 30

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT id), 2) AS sle_percentage
FROM examination
WHERE thrombosis > 0

SELECT p.sex,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM laboratory l
           WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.cre >= 1.5
       )) AS abnormal_patients,
       COUNT(*) AS total_patients,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM laboratory l
           WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.cre >= 1.5
       )) / COUNT(*), 1) AS percentage
FROM patient p
WHERE p.sex IN ('M', 'F')
GROUP BY p.sex

SELECT DISTINCT t.admission, t.id, t."T-CHO"
FROM (
    SELECT p.admission, p.id, l."T-CHO",
           MAX(l."T-CHO") OVER (PARTITION BY p.admission) AS max_cho
    FROM laboratory l
    JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
    WHERE p.admission IN ('+', '-')
      AND l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE t."T-CHO" = t.max_cho
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.admission = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, t.id

SELECT DISTINCT p.id,
       date_part('year', age(DATE '2026-10-09', p.birthday))::int AS age
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
WHERE l.ldh > 600 AND l.ldh < 800
  AND CASE
        WHEN trim(l."U-PRO") ~ '^(>=|>|≥)?\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
        THEN regexp_replace(trim(l."U-PRO"), '[^0-9.]', '', 'g')::numeric >= 300
        ELSE FALSE
      END

WITH r AS (
    SELECT p.id, CAST(l.rnp AS numeric) AS lvl
    FROM patient p
    JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p."First Date") = 1991
      AND l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
)
SELECT DISTINCT id, lvl AS rnp
FROM r
WHERE lvl = (SELECT MAX(lvl) FROM r)

WITH last_lab AS (
    SELECT id, MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM laboratory
    GROUP BY id
    HAVING MAX(date) > DATE '1997-01-01'
),
last_sc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170
    FROM laboratory
    WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sc170) <> ''
    ORDER BY id, date DESC
)
SELECT l.id
FROM last_lab l
JOIN last_sc s ON s.id = l.id
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(s.sc170)) IN ('negative', '0')

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE TRIM(p.admission) = '+') AS admitted,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE TRIM(p.admission) = '-') AS outpatient
FROM patient p
WHERE p.diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM laboratory l
      WHERE l.id = p.id
        AND substring(l."U-PRO" from '[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*') IS NOT NULL
        AND CAST(substring(l."U-PRO" from '[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*') AS numeric) >= 30
  )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
WHERE p.admission = '-'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.ra IN ('-', '+-')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM examination e
    WHERE e.id = p.id
      AND (e.kct = '+' OR e.rvvt = '+' OR e.lac = '+')
  )

SELECT AVG(hct) AS avg_hct
FROM (
    SELECT hct,
           CASE
               WHEN "U-PRO" ~ '^\s*(>=|=>|>|≥)?\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$'
               THEN CAST(substring("U-PRO" from '([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)') AS numeric)
               ELSE NULL
           END AS pro_val
    FROM laboratory
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date") = 1991
      AND hct IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE pro_val >= 300

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM (
    SELECT id
    FROM laboratory
    WHERE ssa IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(ssa)) NOT IN ('-', 'negative', '0', '')
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id
    FROM laboratory
    WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM("U-PRO")) NOT IN ('-', 'negative', 'none', '0', '')
) t

SELECT s.label AS sex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS patient_count
FROM (VALUES ('F', 'female'), ('M', 'male')) AS s(code, label)
LEFT JOIN patient p
       ON p.sex = s.code
      AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM laboratory l
            WHERE l.id = p.id
              AND l.hgb < 7.0
          )
GROUP BY s.label

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND CASE WHEN l.dna ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN l.dna::numeric END < 8

SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS numeric))
FROM laboratory
WHERE cre < 1.5
  AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'

WITH f AS (
    SELECT "id", "date", "rnp", "rnp"::numeric AS rnp_num
    FROM laboratory
    WHERE "got" >= 60
      AND "rnp" ~ '^\s*[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?\s*$'
)
SELECT "id", "date", "rnp"
FROM f
WHERE rnp_num = (SELECT MAX(rnp_num) FROM f)

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM patient p
WHERE p.admission <> '-'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND l.alp >= 300
  )

SELECT CASE WHEN p.admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
            ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "group",
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.ldh < 500) AS normal_ldh_count
FROM patient p
LEFT JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY p.admission
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.admission = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM patient p
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND p.admission LIKE '+%'
  AND p.birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01'
  AND p.birthday <= DATE '1989-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM examination e
    WHERE e.id = p.id
      AND e."ANA Pattern" = 'P'
  )

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS patients_with_lab_results,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN l.id END) AS patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
WHERE p.sex IS NULL OR TRIM(p.sex) = ''

SELECT p.id, p.sex, l.date, l."U-PRO"
FROM patient p
JOIN (
    SELECT id, date, "U-PRO",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS rn
    FROM laboratory
    WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" <> ''
) l ON l.id = p.id AND l.rn = 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, date, got, rnp
    FROM laboratory
    ORDER BY id, date ASC
) f
WHERE f.got < 60
  AND CASE WHEN f.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN f.rnp::numeric END > 10

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM patient p
WHERE p.birthday > DATE '1980-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.id = p.id
      AND (
        l.fg < 150 OR l.fg > 450
        OR TRIM(l."U-PRO") IN ('3', '4')
        OR (
          CASE
            WHEN TRIM(l."U-PRO") ~ '^(>=)?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
              THEN REPLACE(TRIM(l."U-PRO"), '>=', '')::numeric >= 300
            ELSE FALSE
          END
        )
      )
  )

SELECT DISTINCT p.id
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.admission = '-'
  AND l.cpk < 250
  AND CASE WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN l.rnp::numeric > 4 ELSE FALSE END

WITH pts AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.sex
    FROM patient p
    WHERE p.admission = '-'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM laboratory l
          WHERE l.id = p.id AND l.hgb < 10
      )
),
r AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.sex,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN l.rnp::numeric END) AS m
    FROM pts p
    JOIN laboratory l ON l.id = p.id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.sex
)
SELECT id, sex, m
FROM r
WHERE m = (SELECT MAX(m) FROM r)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)
FROM laboratory l
JOIN examination e ON e.id = l.id
WHERE l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
  AND CAST(l.rnp AS numeric) > 0
  AND e.thrombosis = 0

SELECT p.birthday
FROM patient p
JOIN (
    SELECT l.id, MAX(l.gpt) AS max_gpt
    FROM laboratory l
    WHERE l.gpt < 60
      AND l.id IN (
          SELECT id
          FROM laboratory
          WHERE CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN rnp::numeric END >= 16
      )
    GROUP BY l.id
) t ON p.id = t.id
ORDER BY t.max_gpt DESC, p.id ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
FROM patient p
JOIN laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.sex = 'F'
  AND l.pt < 14
  AND CASE WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN l.rnp::numeric >= 16 ELSE FALSE END

SELECT date_part('year', age(l."date", p.birthday))::int AS age,
       p.diagnosis
FROM laboratory l
JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
WHERE p.admission = '+'
  AND trim(l.dna) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
ORDER BY trim(l.dna)::numeric DESC, l."date" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.id) l.id, l.igg
    FROM laboratory l
    JOIN patient p ON p.id = l.id
    WHERE p.admission = '-'
      AND l.igg IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY l.id, l.date DESC
) t
WHERE t.igg >= 2000

SELECT p.id, p.sex
FROM patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM laboratory l

WITH rare AS (

rare_atoms AS (

atom_bonds AS (

SELECT ra.molecule_id,

SELECT a2.element, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count

WITH bc AS (
    SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
      AND bond_type IN ('-', '=')
    GROUP BY bond_type
),
pc AS (
    SELECT bo.bond_type,
           COUNT(DISTINCT LEAST(a1.element, a2.element) || '|' || GREATEST(a1.element, a2.element)) AS pair_count
    FROM bond bo
    JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = bo.bond_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE bo.molecule_id = 'TR377'
      AND bo.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
    GROUP BY bo.bond_type
)
SELECT bc.bond_type,
       bc.bond_count,
       COALESCE(pc.pair_count, 0) AS element_pair_count,
       m.label
FROM bc
LEFT JOIN pc ON pc.bond_type = bc.bond_type
CROSS JOIN molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
ORDER BY bc.bond_count DESC, bc.bond_type ASC

WITH atom_counts AS (
    SELECT molecule_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_atoms,
           SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_carbon,
           SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_chlorine
    FROM atom
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(element) = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
bond_counts AS (
    SELECT molecule_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
           SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_multiple
    FROM bond
    GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_bonds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.bond_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE LOWER(a.element) = 'c'
),
carbon_bond_counts AS (
    SELECT b.molecule_id,
           COUNT(*) AS num_carbon_bonds
    FROM bond b
    JOIN carbon_bonds cb ON cb.bond_id = b.bond_id
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY COALESCE(cbc.num_carbon_bonds, 0) DESC,
                 ac.num_atoms DESC,
                 m.molecule_id ASC
    ) AS rank,
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    ac.num_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.num_bonds, 0) AS num_bonds,
    ac.num_carbon,
    ac.num_chlorine,
    COALESCE(cbc.num_carbon_bonds, 0) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
    COALESCE(bc.num_multiple, 0) AS num_multiple_bonds
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom_counts ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
LEFT JOIN carbon_bond_counts cbc ON cbc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
ORDER BY rank

WITH triple_elements AS (

WITH atom_bonds AS (

single_only AS (
